assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow that fetches and harmonizes regional disease- or trait-association summary statistics from an accession.
assessments.rationale: This skill facilitates sprint retrospectives and has no association-statistics retrieval capability.
It accepts a GCST accession and GRCh38 interval, then returns harmonized per-variant identifiers, positions, alleles, beta, standard error, and p-values.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A regional association-summary-statistics fetcher accepting a study accession and chromosome bounds.
assessments.rationale: This skill performs GO and KEGG enrichment from gene lists rather than retrieving variant association statistics.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Support for an association-study accession and disease- or trait-GWAS regional summary statistics rather than protein-specific pQTL data.
assessments.rationale: It returns harmonized regional association rows, but its required inputs and source are UKB-PPP protein pQTL measurements rather than an association-study accession for a disease or trait.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A regional association-summary-statistics retrieval and harmonization workflow.
assessments.rationale: This skill operates LM Studio model servers and does not access genetic association data.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow that retrieves regional disease- or trait-association summary statistics from an accession.
assessments.rationale: This skill guides instrumental-variable analysis and does not retrieve variant-level association statistics.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Support for an association-study accession and disease- or trait-GWAS regional summary statistics rather than dataset-specific cis-eQTL data.
assessments.rationale: It retrieves harmonized regional association rows, but it is limited to eQTL Catalogue dataset identifiers and molecular QTL data rather than a disease or trait association-study accession.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A study-accession-based regional association-summary-statistics fetch and harmonization workflow.
assessments.rationale: This skill governs spreadsheet creation and editing, not association-study data retrieval.
